firstPlayerRule: The most recent person to watch a kung-fu movie starts. Turns then proceed clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The solo game uses one player's Taoist and three neutral boards; it does not require choosing between several human players.
